# Phytomem Lab

> Phytomem Lab is a Health & Fitness > Brain & Memory Supplement. Phytomem One is a stimulant-free brain and memory supplement from Phytomem Lab built around a botanical trio of saffron, berberine and cinnamon. Rather than leaning on caffeine or synthetic stimulants for a short jolt of alertness, it is positioned as a daily-use formula for people who want steady support for memory recall, mental focus and day-to-day clarity. The capsules are designed to slot into an ordinary morning routine, making Phytomem One a simple option for adults who feel their concentration or recall is not quite where it used to be and who prefer a plant-based, stimulant-free approach to brain health.
